meta.title: Repository-side academic verification of review-pending resources
meta.scope: Every resource whose reviewStatus was review-pending at commit c9f012d (780 resources)
meta.method: Each resource read in full and checked against its own official specification (awarding-body PDFs; public IB subject briefs where the full guide is licensed). Every numerical worked example and answer recomputed in Python. Errors corrected with the smallest possible edit; judgement calls recorded as minor open issues.
meta.whatThisIsNot: Not a teacher review and not a sign-off. No reviewStatus, reviewer, reviewedDate, author or publishedDate was changed. Every resource here remains review-pending until a named, authorised Marlbridge reviewer accepts it under the editorial policy.
